question: Where were the 5th edition of the Khelo India Youth Games held in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The fifth Khelo India Youth Games was organized in Madhya Pradesh from January 30 to February 11.
 
• As many as 6,000 players have participated in 23 sports items in 8 different cities for 13 days.
 
• Union Minister of State for youth affairs and Sports Nisith Pramanik was present as a special guest at the opening event.
 
• While all the sports events was organized in Madhya Pradesh, one game (cycling) was organized in Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• After the inaugural edition in New Delhi in 2018, Maharashtra hosted the event in 2019 while Assam was the venue in 2020.
 
• The 2021 edition, which was postponed due to COVID-19, was held in June 2022 in Haryana.
